svg.text: Body: a box 60 wide x 44 deep x 130 tall outside, walls 2.5,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: open at the front. Print it back face down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back face: four 4.4 mm holes, 8 in from each side and from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the top and bottom, for M4 screws into the bracket plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left side: 8 mm hole for the cable gland, 20 up from the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor: 12 mm hole for the LED head socket, 8 in from the left

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side and 15 behind the lid's front face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inside: bosses with M3 heat-set inserts for the modules, and a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pocket for the lid reed switch near the front top corner.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lid: 60 x 130 x 2.5. UV level bar: five windows 6 wide x 8 tall,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2 apart, centred across, 22 to 30 below the top; print the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: segments in clear PETG. Magnet; four M3 screws to the body.
